comment: An RGB glyph customization on the fountain and on the showrace dwarf hero. wintty.c tty_print_glyph() (3893-3913) prints an RGB customcolor with term_start_extracolor() when colorcount >= 256 (TERM=xterm-256color) and skips term_start_color(), which is the only call recorder patch 006 hooks, so both cells keep the default foreground; the hero's showrace HI_DOMESTIC tweak changes only gm.sym.color.
